lines.zh: 我的体重让脚下陷进去。
lines.en: My weight sinks the ground beneath me.

lines.zh: 我的爪子扫开挡路的树。
lines.en: My claws sweep aside the trees in my way.
My shadow is bigger than the grass.

lines.zh: 我走过荒野，砂土翻起来。
lines.en: I cross the waste and the gravel churns.
I pause at the desert's edge.

lines.zh: 我从下界的地面上踩过去。
lines.en: I tramp across the nether ground.
I sniff the wind as I walk.
I don't step aside for anything.
I lower my head and look at my claws.

lines.zh: 热从我的身体里散出来。
lines.en: Heat comes off my body.
Footsteps echo across the waste.
There's hard plating on my back.
I'm scenting a change in the air.
One breath and the sand lifts.
I tilt my head; bones creak.
I stand out here.

lines.zh: 我没有要藏起来的意思。
lines.en: I've no intention of hiding.
My horn caught a branch.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把脚换了个位置。
lines.en: I shift my foot slowly.
I stand far above you.
I have looked you over for some time.

lines.zh: 你这点个头，不够我一口。
lines.en: Your size is less than a mouthful.
Your partner is over there.
I look down at your feet.
Would you like to speak first?

lines.zh: 我身上的热你能感觉到。
lines.en: You can feel the heat off me.

lines.zh: 你没有退路，也没有必要退。
lines.en: No retreat for you, and no need for one.
I am listening.
You are welcome to try running.
I'm quicker than I look.

lines.zh: 这个距离对我不算什么。
lines.en: This distance means nothing to me.
A gash has opened in my hide.
That spark barely tickles.
I gave half a step and stopped.
My panting has grown heavier.

lines.zh: 我这副大身子，转身要一会儿。
lines.en: This bulk takes a while to turn.
That pain was real.
I'll keep fighting regardless.

lines.zh: 这点伤，值得我认真一次。
lines.en: That scratch is worth getting serious over.
I will not touch what is in your hand.
Throw it away.
I'd finish it in one bite.
I'd rather eat something else.
That's not enough to make me stop.
Holding that up must be tiring.
Put it down first, then we'll talk.

lines.zh: 这点东西我一口就没有了。
lines.en: One bite and that would be gone.
One lean and you retreat.
My foot comes down beside you.

lines.zh: 你被我的影子压了一下。
lines.en: My shadow passes over you.
I never gave up the path.
You barely made me lean.
You hit me like a cliff face.
Both of us came away dented.

lines.zh: 你差点被我的尾巴扫到。
lines.en: My tail nearly swept you.
I'm the only one on this waste.
My own kind rarely meet.
Its build is about like mine.
We don't walk side by side.
I know that shadow over there.
We each hold a patch of ground.
There's a gully between us.
Neither of us moved.
I lift it up.
This sort of thing is nothing.
One squeeze and the shell cracked.
I pinch it into the minecart.
Everything on the ground is mine.
I will just keep this one.
It's tiny in my palm.
I looked it over again.
This one's all grit—tossed.
That's all I was waiting for.
Your partner is in front.
My horns have come low.
I need not make a sound.
You are covered in the smell of sweat.

lines.zh: 这一下会带走很多东西。
lines.en: This blow will take a great deal.

lines.zh: 锁定你了，别想跑出射程。
lines.en: Locked on. Don't bother running out of range.
Hyper Heat is warmed up and ready.

lines.zh: 三格半的躯体，朝你走过来。
lines.en: A three-block body walks toward you.
Ten of your steps, one of mine.
One of my steps makes four of yours.
My eyes follow you without pause.
The ground here is wide open.
There's nowhere for you to hide.
My tail sweeps behind me.
Flanking won't help, I can see you.
My palm comes down.
My fist carries heat.
That split the ground.
You back off; I press in again.
That bite found a shoulder.
My claws open your armor.
You barely blocked it.
That sent you sliding.
I flung you aside.
I set foot on this ground.

lines.zh: 沙土裂开，我的角先出来。
lines.en: The ground splits; my horn first.
I know the smell of this place.

lines.zh: 热浪里站起，我扫视一圈。
lines.en: I rise in the heat and scan.
My breath lifts the sand.
I flattened a clump of dry grass.
I don't need to hide.
Everything here is very small.
I stride onto this ground.
I raise a hand to my eyes.

lines.zh: 我落地时整个地面都在动。
lines.en: The whole ground jumps when I land.
Water rises and I struggle slowly.
The blast only pushed me askew.
An arrow hits and bounces off.
Light binds me and I wrench at it.

lines.zh: 这么大的身体，饿得很快。
lines.en: A body this size gets hungry fast.
Lightning hit my back. I flinched.

lines.zh: 这里什么都没有，我踩不实。
lines.en: There's nothing here to stand on.
